ABOUT DMC PLAYER

Made for gamers.
Made by
Darryl McComish.

DMC

A personal project built around a simple idea: keep a show on while you’re playing, without giving up your game screen.

WHY IT EXISTS

For the quieter
moments in a game.

Farming. Driving around FiveM. Putting time into a game while a film, a TV channel or the next episode runs in the corner.

Darryl McComish created DMC Player for that kind of setup: a small window over the game, controls when you need them and a lock so an accidental click doesn't interrupt what you're doing.

It has grown into a full Windows player with direct streams, live channel lists, web services, an optional queue and watch sessions with friends.

THE PRICE IS SIMPLE

FREE.

The player costs nothing.

DMC Player is free to download and use. There’s no DMC subscription and no account needed to download it.

You bring your own media, stream links and any provider accounts or subscriptions. Free software doesn't make a paid service free or remove its viewing requirements.

Download for Windows

WHAT THE PLAYER IS BUILT AROUND

Keep it useful.
Keep it in your control.

01

Your screen

Move and resize the player to suit the game you're playing.

02

Your queue

Save a list when you choose to. Ordinary opens don't create a watch history.

03

Your updates

See when a newer release is available and choose when to download and install it.

UNDER THE HOOD

Built on good tools.

DMC Player uses the VLC engine and LibVLCSharp for media playback, Microsoft .NET for the Windows app and WebView2 for provider websites.

Third-party license notices are included in the application package. Public channel lists are maintained separately by their contributors; broadcaster and service names belong to their respective owners.
